ticket.subject: Any plans for dark mode?
ticket.body_text:
Dear support,

It would be great to have a dark mode in the web app.

Several people on our team have asked for it.

No rush on this, whenever you have a moment. Please add it to the roadmap.

Best regards,
Ingrid Esposito
project manager, Velloran SAS

label_notes: clean feature (feature-dark-mode): a request for something the product does not do is P4; urgency low: no time pressure.
